title: Viral Sequencing, from Gunk to Graph (Two-step, strand-switching)
author: David A Eccles
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bebujanw

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Tube
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube containing heated lysis buffer and a cellulose disc.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of either lysis/RNAse inactivation buffer (10 mM Tris, 10 mM EDTA, 0.5% SDS, 150 mM NaCl) OR extraction buffer #2 (800 mM guanidine hydrochloride, 50 mM Tris [pH 8], 0.5% Triton X100, 1% Tween-20) to the tube.
Add a 3 mm diameter punched disc from Whatman #1 filter paper.

steps.title: Collect and Lyse Sample
steps.instruction: Collect the sample and perform viral lysis to release RNA.

substeps.instruction: Collect sample using a sterile polystyrene swab with a 30mm breakpoint (e.g., Puritan 25-3606-U).
Break the swab and place it into the prepared 1.5 mL tube with lysis buffer.
Vortex the tube for 30 seconds.
Incubate the tube at 60 °C for 10 minutes (range: 10-30 mins) to inactivate viral proteins.

steps.title: Wash Cellulose Disc
steps.instruction: Clean the cellulose disc to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the disc to a new 1.5 mL tube containing 200 µL wash buffer (10 mM Tris [pH 8.0], 0.1% Tween-20) using a pipette tip.
Incubate the tube at room temperature for 1 minute.

steps.title: Prepare cDNA Synthesis Reaction
steps.instruction: Transfer the disc and add components for the first-strand synthesis reaction.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the disc to a new 200 µL PCR tube using a pipette tip.

Add the following components for an 11 µL reaction: 1 µL of 2 µM reverse primers (prefixed with sample-specific barcodes and ONT reverse anchor sequence [5' - ACTTGCCTGTCGCTCTATCTTC - [barcode] - [sequence-specific] - 3']), 1 µL of 10 mM dNTPs, and 9 µL RNAse-free water.
Mix gently by flicking the tube and spin down for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Denature RNA and Anneal Primers
steps.instruction: Heat the sample to denature RNA and then rapidly cool to anneal primers.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 65 °C for 5 minutes.
Snap cool on a pre-chilled freezer block for 1 minute.

steps.title: Prepare Strand-Switching Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the strand-switching mixture in a separate tube.

substeps.instruction: Mix the following in an 8 µL reaction: 4 µL 5X RT Buffer, 1 µL RNAseOUT, 1 µL Nuclease-free water, and 2 µL of 10 µM ONT Strand-switching primer (SSP).
Mix gently by flicking the tube and spin down for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Perform Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Combine the annealed RNA with the strand-switching buffer and reverse transcriptase.

substeps.instruction: Add the strand-switching buffer to the snap-cooled, annealed RNA, mix by flicking, and spin down.
Incubate at 42 °C for 2 minutes.
Add 1 µL of Maxima H Minus Reverse Transcriptase to reach a total volume of 20 µL.
Mix gently by flicking the tube and spin down for 5 seconds.
Incubate according to the provided protocol.

steps.title: Amplify cDNA
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification of the reverse-transcribed cDNA.

substeps.instruction: In four new 200 µL PCR tubes, prepare a 50 µL reaction at room temperature: 25 µL 2X Q5 Hot Start High-Fidelity Master Mix, 1.5 µL cDNA primer (cPRM), 18.5 µL Nuclease-free water, and 5 µL Reverse-transcribed cDNA (pool or single sample).
Amplify using cycling conditions (recommended starting point: 20 cycles for viral RNA).

steps.title: Remove Unextended Primers
steps.instruction: Use Exonuclease 1 to clean the PCR product.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL of NEB Exonuclease 1 (20 units) directly to each PCR tube and mix by pipetting.
Incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes, followed by 80 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Verify Amplification
steps.instruction: Check the product length using a gel or similar QC device.

substeps.instruction: Run 1 µL of amplified product on a gel; note that a smear may appear instead of specific bands due to the strand-switch protocol.

steps.title: Purify cDNA with AMPure Beads
steps.instruction: Clean the amplified cDNA using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 160 µL of resuspended AMPure XP beads to the 1.5 mL tube and mix by pipetting.
Incubate on a gentle agitator (e.g., hula or rotator mixer) for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Spin down for 5 seconds and pellet on a magnet; pipette off the supernatant.
Wash the beads with 200 µL of freshly-prepared 70% ethanol without disturbing the pellet; remove and discard ethanol.
Repeat the ethanol wash with another 200 µL of 70% ethanol and discard.
Spin down for 5 seconds, place on magnet, and pipette off residual ethanol.
Allow to dry for at most 30 seconds (beads should just lose their shiny sheen, do not crack).

steps.title: Elute and Quantify Library
steps.instruction: Resuspend the purified DNA and measure concentration.

substeps.instruction: Remove tube from magnet and resuspend pellet in 12 µL of Elution Buffer (EB).
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Pellet beads on magnet for 5 minutes until the eluate is clear and colorless.
Carefully remove and retain 12 µL of eluate into a clean 1.5 mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Quantify 1 µL of the amplified cDNA library using the Quantus Fluorometer with the ONE dsDNA assay.

steps.title: Prepare Library for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Add adapters and prepare the library for the flow cell.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL of Rapid Adapter (RAP) to the amplified cDNA library.
Mix by pipetting and spin down for 5 seconds.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Store the prepared library on ice until loading.

steps.title: Sequence and Analyze
steps.instruction: Load the library onto the MinION and process the data.

substeps.instruction: Load 20 ng of sequencing library onto a MinION flow cell.
Start the sequencing run using MinKNOW with the SQK-PCS109 sample preparation protocol.
Analyze the run results using RAMPART.
